high-protein-deficit.name: High Protein Shred — 1,900 Cal
high-protein-deficit.description: Aggressive fat loss protocol prioritizing muscle preservation. 750 calorie daily deficit with protein front-loaded. Designed for intermediate/advanced trainees.
high-protein-deficit.notes: Never go below 1,800 cal — below that you lose muscle, not just fat. Protein is the non-negotiable — hit it every day.

breakfast_options.name: Egg & Turkey Scramble Rice Bowl
breakfast_options.instructions: 4oz ground turkey + 2 eggs + 2 egg whites. Pan with olive oil spray, scramble together. Serve over ½ cup basmati. Hot sauce on top.

breakfast_options.name: Japanese BBQ Chicken & Egg Bowl
breakfast_options.instructions: 5oz leftover chicken (Sunday prep) + 2 eggs + ½ cup rice + 1 tbsp Japanese BBQ sauce. Fastest morning option.

breakfast_options.name: Kewpie Egg Salad Toast
breakfast_options.instructions: 4 boiled eggs + 1.5 tbsp Kewpie mayo + salt + white pepper. Mash. Serve on 2 slices 5-grain or sourdough.

breakfast_options.name: Overnight Oats + Scrambled Eggs
breakfast_options.instructions: Prep oats night before: ½ cup oats + ½ cup protein milk + 1 tbsp honey. Morning: 3 eggs + 2 whites scrambled. Zero morning effort.

breakfast_options.name: Thin Bagel + Egg Scramble
breakfast_options.instructions: 1 thin bagel toasted + 3 eggs + 2 egg whites scrambled with ½ tsp Kerrygold. Quickest option on the plan.

lunch_options.name: Chipotle Chicken Rice Bowl
lunch_options.instructions: 5oz Costco Chipotle Chicken + ¾ cup basmati + frozen broccoli (microwaved). Sunday prepped — grab and go.

lunch_options.name: Pan-Seared Chicken + Rice
lunch_options.instructions: 6oz chicken breast (seared Sunday, sliced cold) + ¾ cup rice + hot sauce. Simple and reliable.

lunch_options.name: Ground Turkey Protein Pasta
lunch_options.instructions: 5oz 90/10 turkey + 1½ cups protein macaroni + olive oil + garlic. Reheats perfectly in a container.

lunch_options.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
lunch_options.instructions: Kewpie egg salad on 5-grain bread. Add hard-boiled egg on side to push protein higher.

snack_options.name: ON Gold Standard Whey — Strawberry Banana
snack_options.instructions: 1 scoop + 10–12oz cold water in shaker. Keep tub at desk or in gym bag. REPLACES the White Monster entirely.

snack_options.name: Chobani Protein Yogurt Drink
snack_options.instructions: Grab from work fridge. Zero prep. Check label — aim for under 170 cal and under 10g sugar.

dinner_options.name: Ribeye + Protein Pasta Aglio e Olio
dinner_options.instructions: 5oz ribeye (ripping hot pan, 2–3 min/side, rest 5 min) + 1.5 cups protein spaghetti + aglio e olio sauce. The reward meal.

dinner_options.name: Ground Beef Bolognese
dinner_options.instructions: 5oz 90/10 beef browned + crushed tomatoes + Italian seasoning + pinch sugar. Simmer 20 min. 1.5 cups protein pasta. Batch Sunday.

dinner_options.name: Japanese BBQ Chicken Thighs + Rice
dinner_options.instructions: 7oz thighs + 1.5 tbsp Japanese BBQ sauce + 1 cup basmati. Baste last 2 min — don't add sauce early.

dinner_options.name: Chipotle Chicken + Protein Fettuccine
dinner_options.instructions: 5oz Costco chicken + fettuccine + olive oil + garlic + parmesan. Done in 12 minutes.

dinner_options.name: Ground Turkey Taco Bowl
dinner_options.instructions: 6oz 90/10 turkey + homemade taco seasoning + bell peppers + ½ cup rice + hot sauce.

dinner_options.name: Steak & Egg Rice Bowl
dinner_options.instructions: 5oz ribeye/sirloin + 2 fried eggs over easy + ½ cup rice + Japanese BBQ sauce. Saturday reward meal — earn it.

pre_workout.note: Train fasted. Water only. If energy crashes badly after Week 1, add a banana.

balanced-deficit.name: Balanced Deficit — 1,800 Cal
balanced-deficit.description: Moderate deficit with flexible macros. Sustainable approach for consistent fat loss without feeling restricted. Good for beginners establishing habits.

breakfast_options.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait + Eggs
breakfast_options.instructions: 1 cup Greek yogurt + granola + berries + 2 scrambled eggs. Quick and filling.

breakfast_options.name: Oat Bowl + Protein Shake
breakfast_options.instructions: ¾ cup oats + banana + 1 scoop protein mixed in. Filling and simple.

breakfast_options.name: Egg White Scramble + Toast
breakfast_options.instructions: 4 egg whites + 1 whole egg + 2 slices whole wheat toast + avocado. Balanced macros.

lunch_options.name: Chicken + Veggie Rice Bowl
lunch_options.instructions: 5oz grilled chicken + ½ cup rice + roasted vegetables. Season with anything in the spice guide.

lunch_options.name: Turkey Wrap
lunch_options.instructions: 5oz ground turkey + large tortilla + lettuce + tomato + mustard. Easy to pack.

lunch_options.name: Tuna + Rice Salad
lunch_options.instructions: 1 can tuna + ½ cup rice + olive oil + lemon + herbs. Simple anti-inflammatory meal.

snack_options.name: Protein Shake
snack_options.instructions: 1 scoop whey + water. Hit protein gap.

snack_options.name: Apple + Peanut Butter
snack_options.instructions: 1 medium apple + 1 tbsp natural peanut butter. Good fats and fiber.

snack_options.name: Hard Boiled Eggs + Fruit
snack_options.instructions: 2 hard boiled eggs + 1 piece of fruit. Portable and filling.

dinner_options.name: Grilled Chicken + Sweet Potato + Veg
dinner_options.instructions: 6oz chicken breast + medium sweet potato + steamed broccoli. Classic balanced meal.

dinner_options.name: Turkey Meatballs + Pasta
dinner_options.instructions: Ground turkey meatballs + marinara + whole wheat pasta. Satisfying and filling.

dinner_options.name: Salmon + Rice + Salad
dinner_options.instructions: 5oz salmon (baked) + ½ cup rice + mixed greens + olive oil dressing.

maintenance-muscle.name: Muscle Building — 2,400 Cal
maintenance-muscle.description: Moderate surplus focused on maximizing muscle gain while minimizing fat. High protein with strategic carb timing around workouts.

breakfast_options.name: Mass Egg Bowl
breakfast_options.instructions: 4 whole eggs + 3 egg whites scrambled + 1 cup rice + salsa. High calorie quality breakfast.

breakfast_options.name: Protein Oats + Eggs
breakfast_options.instructions: 1 cup oats + 1 scoop protein + banana + 3 scrambled eggs. Pre-workout fuel.

breakfast_options.name: Big Bagel Scramble
breakfast_options.instructions: Everything bagel + 4 egg scramble + 2oz turkey + cheese. Dense calories for growth.

lunch_options.name: Chicken + Large Rice Bowl
lunch_options.instructions: 7oz chicken breast + 1 cup rice + vegetables. Biggest meal of the day.

lunch_options.name: Ground Beef + Pasta
lunch_options.instructions: 6oz 90/10 beef + 2 cups pasta + marinara. Classic muscle meal.

lunch_options.name: Steak + Potato + Veg
lunch_options.instructions: 6oz sirloin + medium potato + broccoli. Dense quality nutrition.

snack_options.name: Protein Shake + Banana
snack_options.instructions: 1.5 scoops protein + banana blended or eaten alongside.

snack_options.name: Greek Yogurt + Granola
snack_options.instructions: 1 cup Greek yogurt + ½ cup granola. Good casein protein source.

dinner_options.name: Ribeye + Pasta + Salad
dinner_options.instructions: 6oz ribeye + 2 cups pasta + mixed greens. Recovery meal.

dinner_options.name: Salmon + Rice + Veg
dinner_options.instructions: 7oz salmon + 1 cup rice + roasted vegetables. Omega-3s for recovery.

dinner_options.name: Chicken Thighs + Sweet Potato
dinner_options.instructions: 8oz thighs + large sweet potato + broccoli. Calorie dense quality meal.

meal_timing_rules: Log in MyFitnessPal before or during eating — not after
Protein first — always build the meal around the protein source
Drink 8 oz water with every meal
Train fasted when possible — use fat for fuel
